title: SQLite store: migrate-on-open via PRAGMA user_version, central DB path
rationale: SPEC §6.4 mandates the runs/criterion_results/investigation_cache tables; SPEC §2 requires central state (never inside an audited repo). user_version gating gives idempotent migrate-on-open without a tracking table; a single transaction makes insertRun atomic; renderJson reuse guarantees two audits at a pinned scoredAt persist identical report_json.

title: Pivoted history: audit_runs table + composed AuditStore, label#sha256(root) identity, version-matched trends
rationale: SPEC §10 requires legacy preservation without scale mixing and collision-resistant identity without Git; a path-hash identity and per-product tables satisfy both deterministically and offline.

title: History selection reuses step-6 scored-basis verdicts over stored JSON provenance (trellis-ab01)
rationale: src/store/compatible-runs.ts: decodedStoredReport re-validates report_json (audit_runs is shared storage; foreign/corrupt rows read as absent, never compatible) and scoredBasisCompatible calls assessScoredBasis directly — history never re-derives comparability. AuditStore compatible queries now take a reference AuditReport instead of a ReportVersions triple (reportVersions removed): advisory-only provider changes keep one series, changed scored measurement/scoring basis starts a distinct one, and 1.0.0 rows trend with 1.1.0 anchors via the schema-span caveat. No migration was needed — provenance lives in report_json.
